## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or reproduction. External contributions should come from a topic branch in your fork; see the [fork contribution workflow](../CONTRIBUTING.md#fork-contribution-workflow).

## Compatibility

Note any changes to inputs, outputs, defaults, cache keys/formats, or main/post behavior. Write "Unchanged" when applicable.

## Validation

Include the exact commit tested, checks run and their results, plus relevant checks skipped or behavior still unverified. Follow the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

For performance claims, include the workload, revisions, configuration, observations, and limitations described in the [measurement guide](../docs/BENCHMARKS.md).
